thread:
Dmitri V.: Noticed for TerraScale (acct 1580) March invoice missing preemptible GPU line items — invoice total ~ $6,240 lower than portal. Can someone look?

billing-bot: invoice-generator job 2026-09-02T09:10:00Z completed with 1 WARN. WARN: 1 invoice(s) generated with dropped usage groups. job id job_20260902_0910

Hannah T.: Which invoice id?

Dmitri V.: INV-2026-03-01580 (raw: s3://billing-outputs/2026/03/INV-2026-03-01580.json PDF: https://payments.internal.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-03-01580.pdf)

Carlos (Acct): I also see two drafts: INV-2026-03-01580 and INV-2026-03-01580-alt. Both Draft, autopay off. Put hold please.

Liz (CS): Customer flagged that portal shows preemptible gpu hours under "spot-gpu" but invoice has no spot-gpu lines. They want something to show while we investigate.

Hannah T.: Pulling raw. The usage grouping step collapsed rows when resource_type = 'spot-gpu' because a recent change added a filter that only kept resource_type IN ('gpu','gpu-preemptible') — the normalized name is 'spot-gpu' now. So group dropped entirely.

Hannah T.: Problem snippet:
```sql
WHERE resource_type IN ('gpu','gpu-preemptible') -- missed normalization to 'spot-gpu'
```

Dmitri V.: Ok plan: (1) patch usage-agg to include 'spot-gpu' or use enum set, (2) re-run aggregation for acct 1580, (3) regenerate invoice, (4) void duplicate draft. Can we also provisionally credit so CS can reassure TerraScale?

billing-bot: action logged: invoice_hold applied on INV-2026-03-01580 by Carlos (Acct) at 2026-09-02T09:22:11Z

Carlos (Acct): Created provisional credit PC-2026-09-0007 for $6,240.00 linked to both drafts and added note "missing spot-gpu lines".

Hannah T.: Opened PR https://git.internal.redwood/usage-agg/pulls/312 1 updates normalization and unit tests. Requesting deploy to staging.

Dmitri V.: Reprocess steps once deployed:
```bash
usage-aggregate --account 1580 --start 2026-03-01 --end 2026-03-31 --mode repair --include-resource spot-gpu
billing-reprocess --account 1580 --period 2026-03 --mode regenerate --reason "missing spot-gpu lines"
```

Hannah T.: Deployed to prod and kicked off re-agg + reprocess at 2026-09-02T10:05:00Z. job id job_reproc_1580_202603.

billing-bot: job_reproc_1580_202603 completed at 2026-09-02T10:27:31Z. Result: regenerated invoice uploaded s3://billing-outputs/2026/03/INV-2026-03-01580-corrected.pdf. Duplicate draft INV-2026-03-01580-alt voided.

Carlos (Acct): Verified corrected invoice includes spot-gpu lines and totals match portal. Converted provisional credit PC-2026-09-0007 to official credit memo CM-2026-09-0019 and applied (linked to original draft in case of disputes). Informed TerraScale CS and offered to reimburse any processor fees.

Dmitri V.: Thanks all. Adding FIN ticket FIN-5312 with root cause: resource_type name drift; actions: stricter enum handling in usage-agg, a reconciliation alert for invoice vs portal delta > $1000, and dedupe on draft creation to prevent duplicates. :thumbsup:
